summary.text: Lesley Lopez is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 39 who was first elected in 2018 and has served since January 9, 2019, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A communications professional, she serves on the Health Committee, where she chairs the Elder and Long-Term Care Subcommittee.

paragraphs.text: Lesley Lopez was born on November 28, 1983, and earned a B.A. in comparative politics and Spanish literature from the University of California, San Diego, and an M.P.A. from George Washington University, according to her General Assembly biography.

She worked as a news desk producer at Eurovision Americas and a producer for BBC News, press secretary to U.S. Representative Henry Cuellar, and communications director of the Congressional Hispanic Caucus, the National Immigration Forum and the Democratic Legislative Campaign Committee.
She was communications and publications director at the U.S.-China Business Council from 2015 to 2017 and has been chief communications officer at Run for Something since 2017.
Lopez served on the Judiciary Committee from 2019 to 2023 and the Health and Government Operations Committee from 2023 to 2025, and she has been on the Health Committee in 2026.
She was Deputy Majority Whip from 2023 to 2025 and is the immediate past president of Women Legislators of Maryland, having served as president in 2022 to 2023.
Ballotpedia reports that she advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
